rows.label: bf04270100_0015
rows.name:
There are indeed ruins of a factory there
that was abandoned thirty years ago.

rows.label: bf04270100_0020
rows.name: So, is this what you call 'bingo'?

rows.label: bf04270100_0030
rows.name:
We can't be certain
unless we investigate.

rows.label: bf04270100_0060
rows.name:
We won't do anything reckless. If it seems
dangerous, we'll turn back. How's that sound?

rows.label: bf04270100_0080
rows.name:
To tell the truth, it would be difficult for me
to dispatch the military so quickly. Would you?

rows.label: bf04270100_0100
rows.name: We've obtained some information as well.

rows.label: bf04270100_0110
rows.name:
There are rumors that a politically connected
Nopon merchant is involved in this.

rows.label: bf04270100_0120
rows.name:
A politically connected Nopon merchant...
You mean...

rows.label: bf04270100_0140
rows.name:
We're tracing the money now.
I'll let you know if we find anything.

rows.label: bf04270100_0160
rows.name:
Well, once I can mobilize the army,
I'll follow after you.
